hook: What if you could control your AI coding agents directly from your iPhone?
body: Well, a new open-source project called CodeMote just launched, letting you do exactly that. Trending on Product Hunt, CodeMote enables you to drive *any* command-line interface AI agent  like Claude Code or Codex  straight from your phone. Think remote code generation and task management, transforming your iPhone into a powerful, portable dev control center.
